cases.subject: Braudel, Ariès and Dosse
cases.assessment: Prost’s particular Braudel criticism is verified and proposed, expressly using Dosse-mediated remarks about determinism. Braudel is also used as an authority on retrospective hindsight; this coexistence does not invalidate the narrowly scoped criticism. Ariès’s quoted objection to anti-philosophical self-confidence remains a specific introductory resource, without a broader lineage inferred; its wider role and full reception remain unexamined. Dosse retains the named mediator role, not authorship of Braudel’s statements. Original quoted works are not freshly read.
